title: sannantha collina
intro: Sannantha collina, commonly known as the golden button bush, is a species of flowering plant in the family Myrtaceae. It is a small shrub that is native to eastern Australia, and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Sannantha collina include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe and protect the skin. The bioactive constituents of Sannantha collina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
